method: manual source review of .clover/*.java and forum/*.jsp

parameters.name: username
parameters.rationale: Session attribute set at login (Login.java:57), used as identity for authorization in ChangeMessage.java:41-53 and ChangeProfile.java:44-52. Core identity parameter throughout the application.

parameters.name: type
parameters.rationale: Session attribute set at login (Login.java:67). Used for admin authorization checks: sessionType.equals("Admin") in ChangeMessage:41, DeleteForum:27, DeleteReply:29, DeleteThread:27.

parameters.name: user
parameters.rationale: Message author loaded from forum_message.user and compared with sessionUsername to decide whether the current user may edit the message.
